HYDRATION_PENDING.condition: FD5 frame issued but exact ACK not yet accepted
HYDRATION_PENDING.fd6: pipe identity may be established but mutations are not authoritative

ACTIVE_OWNER.condition: Exact FD5 ACK accepted and FD6 pipe bound to the same complete identity

EXIT_DETECTED.condition: BackendProcessHost observed the real child exit and closed the old FD6 pipe

OWNER_EXIT_RECOVERY.condition: CredentialVaultHost serialized queue terminates the old owner transaction and verifies authority projection

UNAVAILABLE.condition: Owner transaction cannot be deterministically committed or rolled back

restartRule: A new backend may be scheduled only after real child exit, old pipe close, owner-exit recovery, empty activeTransactionId and ACTIVE authority.
pidReuseRule: PID equality alone never establishes ownership. Every identity field must match.
